snippet.title: Denshattack! - Creator Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Meet the creators joining Denshattack! 🚄✨

They're bringing custom skins, stellar voice performances and plenty of chaos to the tracks.

Take to the rails and flip trick your way to the top! High-speed chaos meets the scenic railway routes of Japan with over 60 levels, epic boss fights, and of course, multi-track drifting!

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2524850/Denshattack/
